news.title: AU Small Finance Bank Limited Introduces Zero-Forex-Margin Remittances
news.body: AU Small Finance Bank Limited has launched a customer-centric forex proposition aimed at eliminating embedded charges on international fund transfers. With this offering, AU SFB becomes the only Indian bank in the private sector to provide zero forex margin and zero bank charges on both inward and outward remittances, enabling customers to transfer money to and from India at truly transparent exchange rates, without any hidden mark-ups. The initiative covers outward remittances (Send Money Abroad) under the Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS) for resident Indians sending funds overseas for education, family maintenance, investments and other RBI permitted purposes as well as inward and outward remittances for NRIs through AU NRE and NRO accounts. news.body: Up from ₹1,014, the current price target is an average from 25 analysts. New target price is 6.9% above last closing price of ₹1,016. Stock is up 50% over the past year. The company is forecast to post earnings per share of ₹48.25 for next year compared to ₹35.40 last year.

news.title: AUBANK: New CFO Appointment And Stable Margins Will Support Re Rating
news.body: Analysts have nudged their price target for AU Small Finance Bank up from ₹1,250 to ₹1,275, reflecting updated assumptions around discount rate, revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E that together support a slightly higher fair value estimate. What's in the News The board has approved the appointment of Gaurav Jain as Chief Financial Officer, effective April 27, 2026, following his service as Interim CFO since September 26, 2025 (Key Developments).

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹35.40 (vs ₹28.32 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹35.40 (up from ₹28.32 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹104.8b (up 20% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹26.4b (up 25% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 25% (up from 24% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 21% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 1.6% growth forecast for the Banks industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 14% per year and the company’s share price has also increased by 14% per year.

news.title: AU Small Finance Bank Limited Appoints Gaurav Jain as Chief Financial Officer, Effective April 27, 2026
news.body: AU Small Finance Bank Limited at the board meeting held on April 27, 2026 announced the appointment of Mr. Gaurav Jain as Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of the Bank with effect from April 27, 2026. Mr. Gaurav Jain was earlier appointed as Interim Chief Financial Officer of the Bank with effect from September 26, 2025. An all-India rank holder Chartered Accountant and an MBA from the Kellogg School of Management, Mr. Jain brings over two decades of distinguished global leadership experience spanning India, London, and New York. He possesses deep expertise across financial stewardship, M&A & strategic transformation, digital enablement, and governance, having held senior leadership roles at globally renowned institutions including Morgan Stanley, Lloyds Banking Group, Tech Mahindra, and PwC.

news.title: AU Small Finance Bank Limited Proposes Dividend for the Financial Year Ended on March 31, 2026
news.body:
AU Small Finance Bank Limited at the board meeting held on April 27, 2026 recommended dividend of INR 1 (Rupee One) per equity share of face value of INR 10 each fully
paid up (i.e. 10% of face value) out of net profit for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, subject to approval of shareholders at the ensuing Annual General Meeting ("AGM") of the Bank. The dividend on equity shares will be paid/dispatched after the same is approved by the shareholders at the ensuing AGM of the Bank.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹8.94 (vs ₹7.10 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹8.94 (up from ₹7.10 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹27.3b (up 28% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹6.68b (up 26% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 24% (in line with 3Q 2025). Revenue is forecast to grow 23% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 2.5% growth forecast for the Banks industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 12% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 17% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
